newsitem.title: USA: LCRA to shut 430 MW Texas gas plant for repairs.
newsitem.headline: LCRA to shut 430 MW Texas gas plant for repairs.

text.p: Lower Colorado River Authority (LCRA) said Friday it will shut its 430 megawatt (MW) natural gas-fired Ferguson power plant later today to repair a leaking boiler tube.
The outage will last approximately five days, a company spokeswoman said.
The leak was discovered after the Ferguson plant tripped off line briefly Thursday when technicians took an oil sample from its transformer.
The Marble Falls, Tx., generating station had just resumed operation Wednesday following a superheater tube rupture on Wednesday October 3.
The Ferguson facility produces eight percent of LCRA's electricity output.
